name: Marauders of Darrowshire
label: Quest
description: Marauders of Darrowshire: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Chromie said the relics you gathered are reagents to a powerful spell, and one more is required: skulls from the scourge who took part in the battle of Darrowshire.

Take this crystal and hunt scourge champions for their skulls. The crystal is enchanted; if a champion took part in the battle, then when you pass the crystal over its skull it will resonate. Bring me those resonating skulls.
Go, friend. You'll find scourge champions in the Noxious Glade to the north and the Fungal Vale to the west.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the skulls? Chromie said they will be critical for her spell, and that spell will give us the chance to save Darrowshire.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Although I don't fully understand how they can help us, I feel their power and I know in my bones that they are linked to my home village of Darrowshire.
